items.q: and I remember talking to Harry Carney, we were between shows, standing on

ctx.x: No-one told me, right. You know, if you're working for Jim Jones you ask Jim Jones for the money. But this is big time. He had a manager.

Well, anyway, to make a story, that's the way it happened, and of course it went down and we played the six weeks at the Paramount Theater, which was real beautiful, real fine. And I remember between shows, they were getting ready to close the last week of the engagement, and I remember talking to Harry Carney, we were between shows, standing on

the sidewalk on 44th Street. I didn't even have any bags. You know, these guys, they've got their bags and they've been doing it for years.. So I said, "Well, what do you think kind of bags I should get, you know?" He said, "Well, most of the fellows have a big bag, what they call the big bag, and a small bag." That's what they called them. Oh. So I said, "Okay, I'll go buy a big bag and a small bag." So I bought a big bag and a small bag. The big bag was like a trunk, you know, and they kept that under the bus,…
